zh.title: Textron以12億美元出售工業部門
zh.summary: Textron簽訂12億美元出售工業部門協議，預計2027上半年完成。
body: Textron於2026年11月18日確認，已簽訂一項確定性協議，將其工業部門以12億美元出售。
交易預計於2027年上半年完成，仍須取得必要的監管批准。此舉將使Textron專注於航空與防務核心業務。
完成後，Textron將更名為New Textron，旗下將保留Cessna、Beechcraft、Bell及Textron Systems等航空與防務品牌。同時，Kautex與Textron Specialized Vehicles等工業子公司將轉讓給Kingswood Capital Management的關聯公司。

en.title: Textron to sell industrial segment for $1.2B
en.summary: Textron agreed to sell its industrial arm for $1.2 billion, closing expected in early 2027.
body: Textron confirmed on November 18, 2026 that it has entered a definitive agreement to sell its industrial arm for $1.2 billion.
The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to required regulatory approval, allowing the company to focus on its core aerospace and defense businesses.

Upon completion, the firm will be renamed New Textron and will retain the Cessna, Beechcraft, Bell and Textron Systems brands. Industrial subsidiaries such as Kautex and Textron Specialized Vehicles will be transferred to an affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management.
